info.title: AzureDevOpsMcp
info.description:
MCP stdio server exposing Azure DevOps through its REST API: projects, repositories, pull
      requests, work items, pipelines and search (code, work items, wiki), read-only. Signs in to
      Entra ID once interactively and runs silently thereafter.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: MCP stdio server for one Azure DevOps organization.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Register this server in the MCP client config of the repository around the given directory.

options.name: --client
options.description: claude | vscode | cursor (default: whichever the repository shows signs of).

options.name: --file
options.description: Write this file instead of the client's own config path.

options.name: --name
options.description: Key for this server in the config.

options.name: --set
options.description: Add or override an env entry as KEY=VALUE; KEY= removes one; repeatable.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace an existing entry that differs. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the resulting file, write nothing. [default: False]

arguments.name: DIRECTORY
arguments.description: Where to start looking for the repository (default: current directory).

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Interactive sign-in that primes the persisted token cache; run once before the server.

commands.name: selftest
commands.description: Silent-auth and a REST round-trip, with raw errors on the console.

commands.name: config
commands.description: Validate and print the server's data files (deployment map).

commands.name: call
commands.description: Invoke one tool through the real server path and print its result as JSON.

arguments.name: TOOL
arguments.description: The tool to invoke; omit to list the tools.

arguments.name: ARGUMENTS
arguments.description: KEY=VALUE pairs, one JSON object, or '-' to read a JSON object from stdin.
